notes.title: V0.5.0 Roguelike Mode Release
notes.notes: [h1]Welcome or Welcome Back![/h1][p]Finally, the main part of the game. Final Notice now has a functioning (albeit a little lean) roguelike mode. Let's talk about expectations, both with the new mode and the future, and what the upcoming plan is.[/p][p][/p][h1]Roguelike Mode: How does it work?[/h1][p]I mentioned how the general cycle goes in the beta announcement from a couple of days ago, so I'll repost that:[/p][olist][*][p]Start a new run, picking a smaller-than-usual preset deck based on their normal preset counterparts[/p][/*][*][p]Fight the first boss, a difficulty 1 boss and, hopefully, win![/p][/*][*][p]Choose from 3 different sets of 5 cards to add to your deck[/p][/*][*][p]Choose from 2 different passives to add to your run[/p][/*][*][p]Face a boss from the difficulty up[/p][/*][*][p]Repeat this until you lose.[/p][/*][/olist][p]The number of passives, bosses and card selections you get will of course increase with time, right now we've just got the 11 bosses from the bounty mode and around 12 passives that you can end up with. There isn't a limit to the mode, so you can go until you lose, but naturally you're probably going to run into the same bosses fairly frequently. Because of that, the primary focus for the game, at least for a while, will be new bosses, passives and cards for the card pools.[/p][p]Speaking of...[/p][p][/p][h2]New Boss: Prometheus[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/468827055c311d3132a6f10ed7f203ef2713b444.png"][/img][/p][p]Prometheus is our newest boss, a difficulty 1 boss, who's primary game revolves around his addition of the card "Kindling" into your hand.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/ecc9f35d915e5b94c3e074d5a1542efb78f16a29.png"][/img][/p][p]The concept for Kindling was, from my own playtesting, that it felt pretty good to get something out of cards like these, to use them as fuel for "select a card to banish" type cards or as card draw, but it's obviously not supposed to be completely free. Kindling is always burning when it hits your hand too, so there's some synergy there with cleanse cards that provide extra effects.[/p][p]Other than that, Prometheus, being a titan, hits quite hard in general, and that only increases as you use his Kindling, so be careful on your usage. He doesn't utterly flood your hand with the card the same as Kalfu or the other Voodoo bosses tend to, so don't worry too much about having to keep cards around that clear hand space.[/p][p][/p][h2]The Future[/h2][p]I mentioned it a little above, but I'll be primarily working on bosses from here on out, then passives, then card pools. Ideally I'd like every roguelike run to feel different, but to do that it's going to require a lot of content. Right now they're pretty individual, I think you can get a solid few hours out of the runs before they get a little samey, but you tell me. Best place to do that, and to keep up to date with the game is, of course, by joining the discord. [/p][p]You can scroll to the bottom of the page to find the link, looks like a little discord icon.[/p][p]With all that said-[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][i]Till next time, and[/i][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Bounties Update! - V0.4.0
notes.notes: [h1]Welcome or Welcome Back![/h1][p]Quite the long list of patches today so let's get right into it - I did plan to push this update a bit later in the week, but I'd really like some feedback from all of you regarding the bounty bosses and the massive balance change that's a part of this patch. Give it a look, see what's what.[/p][p]As usual, any player feedback will be marked with (ːsteamhappyː)[/p][p][/p][h1]Bounties![/h1][list][*][p]Added the bounties mode! This mode will be updated with new scripted bosses quite regularly. Pre-warning, the bosses are [i]HARD [/i]and will require some deckbuilding to beat. Some tips for beating them are included in the bounties page when you select a boss.[/p][/*][*][p]Currently, three bosses are added, Zeus, Thoth and Agni. Get into the game and have a go! Eventually bosses like this will be used to get unlocks, special cosmetics and ultimately be part of the roguelike mode.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Balance Changes[/h2][p][i]There's a lot.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Nerfed Exile Dividend to now cost 7 mortis and require 7+ banished cards to draw 2 cards.(ːsteamhappyː)[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed Quick Shuffle to now draw one less card and cost 15 mortis. (ːsteamhappyː)[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed Efficient Filing to now reduce card cost by 2 instead of 3. (ːsteamhappyː)[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed Slipstream Filing to now have a 20 requirement instead of 33 but only restore 1 mortis per turn and banish after play.[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed Ongoing Investigation to now increase boss mortis by 3 instead of 4.[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed Stamped Copy to now increase the boss' mortis by 2 instead of 6.[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed Final Filing to now only draw one card.[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed Time Theft to now cost 7 mortis and require 15 to play.[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed Zero-Tolerance Policy to now burn and fog your whole hand and be banished when played.[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed Refile and Reissue to now banish after being played but no longer cause a discard. (ːsteamhappyː)[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed Carbon Copy to now banish after being played.[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed Soul Bargain to now give 2 cards next turn instead of 3.[/p][/*][/list][p][i]I'll be monitoring balance pretty closely, after playtesting, I believe this has indeed made the game harder, but admittedly a lot more interactive. Hopefully you feel the same, but always provide any feedback regarding the game balance.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]New Cards![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674461/ae973e4dd55d5a27b2327351b92bcaaa1bbf5ac1.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Hot Streak - [/i]Boss gains 12 mortis, but burn the leftmost card in your hand.[/p][p][i]Day at the Beach - [/i]You lose 10 mortis, but waterlog the leftmost card in your hand.[/p][p][i]Gravedig - [/i]Add two Dead Draws to your hand. (A card that does nothing!)[/p][p][/p][h2]UI/Tweaks:[/h2][list][*][p]There is now a "concede" button in the top right of every game window, so you don't have to wait to lose unwinnable games.[/p][/*][*][p]The deckbuilder now has the hover-over tooltips for cards on the right when building a deck.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that was causing system lockups rarely when repeatedly leaving the game window or in some cases where the game window was closed externally.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Hopeful Roll showing the wrong flavour text.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Quite the patch! Tell me what you think of the bosses - I'll be balancing them as we approach 0.5.0.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Till next time![/i][/p]

notes.title: New Cards and First Steam Update - V038
notes.notes: [h1]Welcome (I'd usually say Welcome Back!)[/h1][p]The first steam build is live with a new update featuring a few new cards, some visual fixes and a small update to the boss logic.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Cards:[/h2][h3][i][u]Hopeful Roll[/u][/i][/h3][p]Hopeful Roll increases the boss' mortis by a random number between 0-12, but it has a [i]very [/i]small chance to crit, adding 50 mortis to the boss' total. [i]And I do mean small, 1/1000![/i][/p][p]A card for gamblers, truthfully, not much more to it, gives some direct damage potential and if you get [i]lucky lucky [/i]there'll be a nice free win (probably) as a reward.[/p][p][/p][h3][i][u]Line of Credit[/u][/i][/h3][p]Line of Credit lets you draw cards up to max hand size, 6, but increases your mortis by 3 for each card drawn. It's a more flexible Box of Demise, but costs you for using it. An upcoming bounty boss [i]really [/i]likes playing the long game, so I figured this might be a good way to refuel if you're running into a dead end with momentum.[/p][p][/p][h3][i][u]Flash Sale[/u][/i][/h3][p]Flash Sale discards your whole hand, but increases the boss' mortis by 3 per card, and lowers your own mortis by 3 per card, discarded. Meant as a real "oh, shit" button, the Flash Sale card can also be used by decks that love to stack a massive amount of cards in their hand as a potential finisher, or to hand sculpt while stabilising, to help avoid certain boss effects that would otherwise target your hand.[/p][p][/p][h2]Fixes:[/h2][p]Previously, some of the cards were a liiiiiittle bit illegible if the names were especially long. I'd change some text for the sake of a UI update some time ago, and hadn't ever accounted for the fact it'd change card text too - my bad. This is now mended, so you can stop straining your eyes.[/p][p][/p][p]Also, some bosses, and especially an upcoming bounty boss, had an effect that increased the player's mortis per draw. Welp, that effect happened to carry over games. I've now fixed that, and you won't get bit for an effect you had a game ago.[/p][p][/p][p]If you're completely new to Final Notice, welcome! There's a lot more knowledge and a lot more context over on the itch page [url="https://themokujin.itch.io/final-notice"]here[/url], which I recommend checking out. Otherwise, if you haven't already, wishlist the game! It helps get Final Notice out there.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Till next time![/i][/p]
